data.name: Kallista
data.gender_notes: Kallista is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, this name was given to the most beautiful woman, Helen of Troy. In Christianity, it is used as a name for saints and in biblical references. The name Kallista carries the meaning “Most beautiful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kallista usually hope their child will grow to embody most beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the beauty and grace of God's creation and the inner beauty of a virtuous woman.
data.etymology: Kallista belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Most beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kallista total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: קאליסטה
in_hebrew.meaning: השם קאליסטה מתייחס לנערה היפה והאהובה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאליסטה הוא נגזרת של המילה היוונית קאליסטה, שפירושה היפה ביותר. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורת הנוצרית ומתייחס לנערה יפה ומושכת. המילה קאליסטה עצמה נגזרת מהמילה היוונית קאלוס, שפירושה יופי. השם קאליסטה משמש גם כהתייחסות ליופי פנימי ורוחני.

in_greek.name: Καλλίστα
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Καλλίστα σημαίνει την πιο όμορφη και αγαπημένη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καλλίστα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη καλλιστη, που σημαίνει η πιο όμορφη. Στην παράδοση της Χριστιανικής Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Καλλίστα αναφέρεται σε ένα κορίτσι που είναι όχι μόνο εξωτερικά όμορφο αλλά και εσωτερικά φωτισμένο. Η λέξη καλλιστη σχετίζεται με την λέξη καλος, που σημαίνει ομορφιά. Το όνομα Καλλίστα συμβολίζει την πνευματική και εσωτερική ομορφιά.

in_latin.name: Kallista
in_latin.meaning: The name Kallista means the most beautiful and beloved
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Kallista is derived from the Greek word kalliste, meaning the most beautiful. In Christian tradition, Kallista refers to a girl who embodies both external beauty and inner spiritual light. The term kalliste is linked to the Greek word kalos, signifying beauty. Kallista symbolizes the inner and spiritual beauty that is cherished in Christian values.

in_english.name: Kallista
in_english.meaning: The most beautiful and beloved Christian name
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kallista originates from the Greek term kalliste, meaning the most beautiful. It is used in Christian tradition to signify a girl of exceptional beauty, both inside and out. Derived from the Greek word kalos, meaning beauty, Kallista represents a synthesis of physical attractiveness and spiritual richness. Historically, the name has been associated with virtues of inner light and purity, reflecting the Christian ideals of beauty and grace.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kallista carries with it an air of exquisite beauty and grace, as it was first given to the most beautiful woman in Greek mythology. While the name itself has no clear Christian origins, its authentic meaning and association with beauty can be recognized in several Christian contexts. In the Orthodox Church, for instance, various female saints are given the name Kallista, further emphasizing the connection between the Name and radiant beauty. In the Scriptures, there are several references to the beauty not only of our Lord, but also of His Mother, the Blessed Virgin Mary (Luke 1:45) and of the holy Scripture itself, described as the "living oracles" and "a light to enlighten the Gentiles" (2 Timothy 3:15; cf. Psalm 119:145).
data.spiritual_significance: Kallista is a reminder of the profound spiritual beauty that the Christian life offers us. Much like the beauty of Helen of Troy captured the hearts of all who saw her, the beauty of a Christian life garnered by the righteous living and practices can attract and inspire many. As Christians, we are encouraged to become "holy as He is holy" (1 Peter 1:15-16), striving toward that beauty and grace which is reflective of God's image in us. In this sense, the name Kallista can serve as a spiritual reminder of our calling to become more childlike and pure in our actions and thoughts, trusting in the transformative power of God's unending love for us. Through the virtues of faith, hope, and love, we can strive to live our lives in a manner worthy of this beautiful name, allowing it to inspire us to be more like Christ and radiate His love to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kallista, derived from the Greek word for "most beautiful," is a name deeply rooted in Christian ideals of divine love and grace. It symbolizes the greatest longing for the purest and most beautiful aspects of the divine, evoking images of the Blessed Virgin Mary, the epitome of sacred beauty and love. This name serves as a constant reminder to seek and cherish the beauty present in all things, both within and without, as reflections of the divine.

historical_references.reference: According to Greek legend, Kallista was an Athenian maiden renowned for her extraordinary beauty. She was captured by pirates and sold into slavery in Egypt. The king of Egypt, Ptolemy I Soter, was so captivated by her beauty that he bought her from the pirates and made her his wife. Kallista is said to have inspired the building of the famous Lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

Kallista was also the name of a Christian martyr who lived during the 3rd century AD. She was a noblewoman from Rome who converted to Christianity and refused to marry a pagan man. She was arrested and tortured for her faith, but remained steadfast. She was eventually beheaded and venerated as a saint.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Kallista, derived from Greek mythology, has gained popularity in modern times as a name that evokes beauty, elegance, and a sense of longing or admiration. It is often used in the context of artistic and aesthetic pursuits, particularly in blogging about fashion, home decor, and personal style. On Instagram and Pinterest, users may create boards or posts featuring images of beautiful landscapes, art, or idealized figures with the name Kallista used as a tag or hashtag. The name also has a romantic association, and may be given to daughters or used as a nickname for romantic partners.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Kallista from Rome, Italy embodies the meaning of Kallista - "Most beautiful". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
